_comment: Cell-identity allowlist for Signal #5 (NGAP NG Setup Request).
Every legitimate gNB in this lab must appear here with the EXACT
(PLMN, gNB ID, TAC) tuple it presents in its Global RAN Node ID and
Supported TA List IEs. Any NG Setup Request whose tuple is not listed
here is flagged as a cell-identity allowlist violation (candidate rogue
Values below come straight from config/ueransim/gnb.yaml (the lab's one
legitimate gNB) - they are NOT hardcoded into the detector script, so
the same detector works unmodified against a different lab or a
different set of legitimate cells: just edit this file.
How to read a gNB's own identity to add it here:
- plmn.mcc / plmn.mnc: from the NG Setup Request's Global RAN Node
- gnb_id: from tshark field ngap.gNB_ID (a hex octet string),
interpreted as an unsigned integer of id_length_bits bits. For
this lab's gnb.yaml, nci: '0x0000000100' with idLength: 32 means
gNB-ID = 0x10 (16) - the top 32 of the 36 NCI bits.
- tac: from the Supported TA List's TAC field, tshark field
